Meta-analysis physiological costs of hibernation: Report 5 - IM Arousal

Pablo Capilla-Lasheras

2026-05-04

This R Markdown Notebook contains the initial meta-analysis for the project ‘physiological ’costs’ of hibernation. Specifically, the meta-analysis of arousal.

Dataset and calculation of effect sizes

The dataset for this meta-analysis has been collected from the literature and curated by Pablo Burraco, Marko Prokic and Tamara Petrovic. It contains data on physiological effects of hibernation in different systems. Here a quick snapshot of the first lines of the dataset:

# dataset with raw data
data <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(
  here(
    "./01_data/raw_data/Burraco_et_al_hibernation_arousal.xlsx"
  ),
  colNames = T,
  sheet = 2
)

paged_table(data, options = list(rows.print = 20))

As a summary of the initial dataset:

  • Number of studies: 20
  • Number of species: 12

For this initial meta-analysis, I am going to include all immune (IM) markers and calculate the standarised mean difference (g; with heteroscedastic population variances) as the effect size of analysis comparing arousal versus euthermia. Positive SMD values indicate higher OS values in arousal while negative SMD indicate lower OS values in arousal. This is a summary of the effect size calculation based on the dataset above:

# ES data
data <- readRDS(
  here(
    "./01_data/processed_RDS_data_files/05_IM_metaanalysis_arousal_full_data.RDS"
  )
)
data$obsID <- 1:nrow(data) # observation ID


data$scientific_name <- gsub(
  x = data$Species,
  pattern = "_",
  replacement = " "
)

data$scientific_name_phylo <- data$scientific_name

## data for SMD
df_SMD <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(SMDH)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SMDH.sv))

# matrix with phylogentic correlations
phylo_cor <- readRDS(
  here(
    "./01_data/processed_RDS_data_files/05_IM_phylogenetic_correlations_arousal.RDS"
  )
)

phylo_tree <- readRDS(
  here(
    "./01_data/processed_RDS_data_files/05_IM_phylogenetic_tree_arousal.RDS"
  )
)

tree <- ggtree(phylo_tree, size = 1.2) +
  xlim_tree(c(0, 35)) +
  geom_tiplab(
    aes(
      label = paste0(
        "italic('",
        sub(x = label, pattern = "_", replacement = " "),
        "')"
      )
    ),
    parse = TRUE,
    offset = 0.5,
    size = 5,
    hjust = 0
  )

ggsave(
  filename = here(
    "./03_plots/02_arousal/00b_IM_phylo_tree_arousal.png"
  ),
  plot = tree,
  device = "png",
  height = 150,
  width = 90,
  units = "mm"
)

ggsave(
  filename = here(
    "./03_plots/02_arousal/00b_IM_phylo_tree_arousal.pdf"
  ),
  plot = tree,
  height = 150,
  width = 90,
  units = "mm"
)

Summary of SMD effect size and number of observations included in the meta-analysis:

summary(df_SMD$SMDH)
##    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
## -3.3649 -0.3302  0.2421  0.4210  1.0059  4.8729
  • Number of observation with non-missing SMD: 162
  • Number of studies in the dataset for analysis: 12
  • Number of species in the dataset for analysis: 6

Initial meta-analysis:

This initial model contains only the intercept and four random effects to account for phylogenetic variation and variation between and within studies beyond sampling variance.

## calculate var-cover matrix to control for correlated effect sizes within study and tissue
V <- vcalc(
  vi = SMDH.sv,
  cluster = StudyID,
  subgroup = Tissue,
  grp1 = Arousal_M,
  grp2 = Euthermia_M,
  w1 = Arousal_N,
  w2 = Euthermia_N,
  data = df_SMD
)

# model
model_SMD <- rma.mv(
  yi = SMDH,
  V = V,
  mods = ~1,
  random = list(
    ~ 1 | scientific_name_phylo,
    ~ 1 | Species,
    ~ 1 | obsID,
    ~ 1 | StudyID
  ),
  data = df_SMD,
  R = list(scientific_name_phylo = phylo_cor),
  method = "REML",
  control = list(optimizer = "BFGS"),
  verbose = F
)
saveRDS(
  object = model_SMD,
  file = here(
    './04_models/02_arousal/01b_metamodel_hibernation_IM.RDS'
  )
)
model_SMD <- readRDS(
  file = here(
    './04_models/02_arousal/01b_metamodel_hibernation_IM.RDS'
  )
)
summary(model_SMD)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 162; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
## -240.4833   480.9667   490.9667   506.3737   491.3538   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed                 factor    R 
## sigma^2.1  0.0006  0.0245      6     no  scientific_name_phylo  yes 
## sigma^2.2  0.5350  0.7315      6     no                Species   no 
## sigma^2.3  0.4108  0.6410    162     no                  obsID   no 
## sigma^2.4  0.0000  0.0001     12     no                StudyID   no 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 161) = 402.0264, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se    zval    pval    ci.lb   ci.ub    
##   0.4208  0.3263  1.2895  0.1972  -0.2188  1.0603    
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
i2_SMD <- round(i2_ml(model_SMD), digits = 4) # heterogeneity random effects

Proportion of variation left after accounting for sampling variance and proportion accounted by each random effect:

knitr::kable(
  x = data.frame(
    Variable = names(i2_SMD),
    i2_value_percentage = as.numeric(round(i2_SMD, digits = 3))
  )
) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = F)

Publication bias: small-study effects

df_SMD$inv_eff_ss <- (1 / df_SMD$Arousal_N) + (1 / df_SMD$Euthermia_N)

model_SMD_pb <- rma.mv(
  yi = SMDH,
  V = V,
  mods = ~ 1 + sqrt(inv_eff_ss),
  random = list(
    ~ 1 | scientific_name_phylo,
    ~ 1 | Species,
    ~ 1 | obsID,
    ~ 1 | StudyID
  ),
  data = df_SMD,
  R = list(scientific_name_phylo = phylo_cor),
  method = "REML",
  control = list(optimizer = "BFGS"),
  verbose = F
)
saveRDS(
  object = model_SMD_pb,
  file = here(
    './04_models/02_arousal/06b_pb_metamodel_hibernation_IM.RDS'
  )
)
model_SMD_pb <- readRDS(
  file = here(
    './04_models/02_arousal/06b_pb_metamodel_hibernation_IM.RDS'
  )
)

summary(model_SMD_pb)

Publication bias: time-lag effects

df_SMD$year_scl <- scale(df_SMD$Year)

model_SMD_tl <- rma.mv(
  yi = SMDH,
  V = V,
  mods = ~ 1 + year_scl,
  random = list(
    ~ 1 | scientific_name_phylo,
    ~ 1 | Species,
    ~ 1 | obsID,
    ~ 1 | StudyID
  ),
  data = df_SMD,
  R = list(scientific_name_phylo = phylo_cor),
  method = "REML",
  control = list(optimizer = "BFGS"),
  verbose = F
)
saveRDS(
  object = model_SMD_tl,
  file = here(
    './04_models/02_arousal/07b_timelag_metamodel_hibernation_IM.RDS'
  )
)
model_SMD_tl <- readRDS(

Endotherms vs. ectotherms:

Now, we investigate if the response to hibernation varies across biomarkers of oxidative stress for endotherms and ectotherms. We include four markers:

table(df_SMD$Thermoregulation)
## 
## Ectothermic Endothermic 
##          10         152

Meta-model for endotherms:

## data for SMD
df_SMD_endo <- df_SMD %>%
  filter(!is.na(SMDH)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SMDH.sv)) %>%
  filter(Thermoregulation == 'Endothermic')

## calculate var-cover matrix to control for correlated effect sizes within study and tissue
V_endo <- vcalc(
  vi = SMDH.sv,
  cluster = StudyID,
  subgroup = Tissue,
  grp1 = Arousal_M,
  grp2 = Euthermia_M,
  w1 = Arousal_N,
  w2 = Euthermia_N,
  data = df_SMD_endo
)
  • Number of observation with non-missing SMD: 152
  • Number of studies in the dataset for analysis: 11
  • Number of species in the dataset for analysis: 5
model_SMD_endo <- rma.mv(
  yi = SMDH,
  V = V_endo,
  mods = ~ Biomarker_category - 1,
  random = list(
    ~ 1 | scientific_name_phylo,
    ~ 1 | Species,
    ~ 1 | obsID,
    ~ 1 | StudyID
  ),
  data = df_SMD_endo,
  R = list(scientific_name_phylo = phylo_cor),
  method = "REML",
  control = list(optimizer = "BFGS", nearpd = TRUE),
  verbose = F
)
saveRDS(
  object = model_SMD_endo,
  file = here(
    './04_models/02_arousal/04b_metareg_hibernation_endo_IM.RDS'
  )
)
model_SMD_endo <- readRDS(
  file = here(
    './04_models/02_arousal/04b_metareg_hibernation_endo_IM.RDS'
  )
)

Meta-model for ectotherms:

## data for SMD
df_SMD_ecto <- df_SMD %>%
  filter(!is.na(SMDH)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SMDH.sv)) %>%
  filter(Thermoregulation == 'Ectothermic')
  • Number of observation with non-missing SMD: 10
  • Number of studies in the dataset for analysis: 1
  • Number of species in the dataset for analysis: 1

Only one study in ectotherms dataset. Analysis run to produce plot, but interpretation needs to be cautions.

table(df_SMD_ecto$Biomarker_category)
## 
##   Both Innate 
##      2      8
model_SMD_ecto <- rma.mv(
  yi = SMDH,
  V = SMDH.sv,
  mods = ~ Biomarker_category - 1,
  data = df_SMD_ecto,
  method = "REML",
  control = list(optimizer = "BFGS"),
  verbose = F
)
summary(model_SMD_ecto)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 10; method: REML)
## 
##   logLik  Deviance       AIC       BIC      AICc   
##  -7.0672   14.1344   18.1344   18.2933   20.5344   
## 
## Variance Components: none
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 8) = 16.2762, p-val = 0.0386
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficients 1:2):
## QM(df = 2) = 6.1600, p-val = 0.0460
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##                           estimate      se     zval    pval    ci.lb   ci.ub    
## Biomarker_categoryBoth      0.5488  0.2486   2.2077  0.0273   0.0616  1.0360  * 
## Biomarker_categoryInnate   -0.1396  0.1231  -1.1340  0.2568  -0.3809  0.1017    
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
ecto_plot <- orchard_plot(
  object = model_SMD_ecto,
  mod = 'Biomarker_category',
  group = 'StudyID',
  trunk.size = 1,
  alpha = 0.2,
  cb = FALSE,
  xlab = "Standardised Mean Difference",
  transfm = "none",
  k.pos = 0.5
) +
  scale_fill_okabe_ito() +
  scale_color_okabe_ito() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, angle = 0),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.5),
    label = seq(-1, 1, 0.5)
  )
